messages:
Priya (AE): Urgent - ACME POC can't provision users. Demo in 24h.
ACME IdP: Okta -> https://scim.redwood.ai/orgs/acme returns 403. Body: '{"error":"insufficient_permissions"}'. We used the console key.
Marco (SE): 403 likely missing scim:write scope or trial-tenant defaults disabled SCIM. Can you share the key id?
ACME IdP: key id sk-hosted-acme-01
Marco (SE): That key is a hosted user key; trials strip SCIM. Quick fix: enable tenant SCIM flag and issue a tenant-scoped service key.
DevEx Bot: Admin action CLI: `PATCH /admin/tenants/acme {"enable_scim":true}` -> OK.
Marco (SE): Creating temp service key with scim:read scim:write ttl=86400.
DevEx Bot: Key created: sk-temp-acme-20260601 (delivered to ACME IdP).
ACME IdP: SCIM now 200 for user create. Group sync fails 409 on externalId okta:group:eng.
Marco (SE): 409 means an internal group already exists. Default behavior is reject duplicates. For POC we can link on exact name match. Enable tenant toggle?
Priya (AE): ACME asked to link, they pre-created groups. Please link.
Marco (SE): Toggle applied: scim.group_match=name_link for tenant acme.
ACME IdP: SAML still flaky - "NameID format not supported" for some users. Okta sends email format.
Marco (SE): Our SP prefers persistent NameID. For demo we can enable email fallback with tight audit. Need SOC signoff.
Security (SOC): Approve email NameID fallback for 12h for POC if audit logging enabled and rollback scheduled.
DevEx Bot: Toggle saml.allow_email_nameid=true for tenant acme (expires 12h). Audit logging enabled.
ACME IdP: After changes 98% users SSO. One user missing email claim; we manually provisioned them via SCIM.
Priya (AE): Thanks. Can we get a support key for ACME SREs tomorrow with 8h TTL?
Marco (SE): Will create support key and send via 1:1. Also adding rollback task to revert toggles after 24h.
Priya (AE): Great - I'll inform ACME and prep demo.
Marco (SE): Final note: document steps in onboarding checklist so production onboarding doesn't hit this.
DevEx Bot: Rollback job scheduled at 2026-06-02T20:00:00Z.
